title: Hard-coded UI string inventory
summary: MyAPES Account now ships a regenerable inventory of hard-coded user-facing strings so Language extraction work can track Public, Admin, Auth, and plugin copy down to zero.
changes: Add php artisan lang:inventory to scan Blade and PHP flash, abort, mail, and notification strings offline.
Commit docs/i18n-inventory.md grouped by Public, APES CIC staff, Admin, Auth, and per-plugin sections with stable anchors for extraction issues.
Add config/lang_inventory.php allow-list and a reusable HardCodedStringScanner for later CI hard-coded warnings.
Document inventory paths and regeneration in localisation and architecture docs.
affected_areas: Language extraction checklist for Public, Admin, Auth, and plugins
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.38.x Language line: inventory and scanner only — no broad string extraction or user-visible copy changes.
validation: PHPUnit HardCodedStringInventoryTest (scanner fixture, committed inventory anchors, write path).
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify (or equivalent local verify) on the PR branch before merge.
known_limitations: Inventory counts are heuristic and may include residual false positives; refine the allow-list as extraction proceeds.
No user-facing strings were moved into lang files in this release (extraction is Wave 2).
CI hard-coded warnings (#276) are not enabled yet; this release only publishes the reusable scanner.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Removing docs/i18n-inventory.md and the lang:inventory command has no runtime effect on signed-in product behaviour.
